preconditions.description: The number of elements in the array n must be between 1 and 200,000.
The maximum number of operations k must be between 1 and 200,000.
The positive integer x must be between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element a_i in the array must have an absolute value less than or equal to 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(b_i % x == a_i % x for i, b_i in enumerate(b))
postconditions.description: Each element b_i in the output array must have the same remainder when divided by x as the corresponding element a_i in the input array.
The output array must contain exactly n elements.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(b_i, int) for b_i in b)
postconditions.description: All elements in the output array must be integers.
The product of the elements in the output array must be the minimum possible product achievable with no more than k operations.
